title: Trace identity for the tangential coefficient field (product-rule core of the chart divergence formula)
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ, every open V ⊆ ℝⁿ, every ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ that is C² on V with fderiv ℝ ψ x injective for all x ∈ V, and every u : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ that is C¹ on V, let a(x) := G(x)⁻¹(A(x)* u(x)) with A(x) := fderiv ℝ ψ x and G(x)⁻¹ := Ring.inverse (A(x)* ∘ A(x)). Then for every x ∈ V, writing A := A(x), G⁻¹ := G(x)⁻¹, S := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x and e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1: trace Da(x) + trace(G⁻¹ ∘ A* ∘ S(a(x))) = trace(G⁻¹ ∘ A* ∘ Du(x)) + ⟨u(x) − A a(x), Σ_{l ∈ Fin n} S e_l (G⁻¹ e_l)⟩, all traces being traces of endomorphisms of ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (u : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → (∀ x ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ x)) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u V → let a : Rn n → Rn n := fun x ↦ Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) (u x)); ∀ x ∈ V, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (fderiv ℝ a x).toLinearMap + LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (a x)).toLinearMap = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ u x).toLinearMap + inner ℝ (u x - fderiv ℝ ψ x (a x)) (∑ l : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (EuclideanSpace.single l 1) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))
